name: system_mammoth
description: Mammoth (mammoth34, LLNL, Slurm: pdebug 1 h, pbatch 24 h, no flux broker): check which group-owned data paths this account can read, per group via sg, since a shell and MCP server keep the groups of their start. Load when a dataset or database path gives permission denied, after the user is added to a group, or before choosing a launcher on mammoth.

history.why: Chat d8e7b5f4c86b (Annotate: tax-teller) on mammoth34: all 9 database paths were permission denied, the user was added to ibap and kpath, but the session still carried old groups; paths were probed by hand with sg kpath / sg ibap, and 2 files stayed owner-only (mode 600). The system also schedules with Slurm, not flux.
